verdict.rationale: Klaviyo ships its own AI agents (Composer, Customer Agent), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. The evidence only documents Klaviyo's own MCP server, which external clients like Claude or Cursor connect to. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Klaviyo connecting to or using third-party MCP servers' tools.
